snippet.title: Sandustry Announcement Trailer | Factory Game
snippet.description:
Sandustry is a side-scrolling factory automation game featuring a fully destructible world where every pixel is an individually simulated resource that you can harness, process, mix, or destroy in surprising ways. 

Dig, demolish, and decode everything in sight – build factories, expand logistic networks, and delve deeper underground to unlock new technologies and discover the secrets of an ancient civilization. Also, sand.

➤ Wishlist on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2764460/Sandustry/
